name: com.maicon.scene-analyzer
description: Real-time Unity scene analysis, validation, and authoring exposed to AI agents over MCP. Includes an embedded chat panel (Coder Chat) that talks to a D:\MCP coder runtime via SSE so the dev never leaves Unity. 32 tools (read, analyze, discover, create, modify, post-fx, render settings, screenshots) plus apply_changeset for atomic batch authoring with single-Undo-group semantics.
